input_policy.risk_free_anchor: Analyst VND long-duration benchmark, 4.50%. Not a verified 23 Nov close. HNX 9 Nov trading statistics show ten-year domestic trades spanning 3.38%-4.5032%; this dispersion is not a par curve. Sensitivity covers the valuation consequence.
input_policy.total_equity_premium: Analyst total VND equity premium of 8%, including local equity/country risk. Do not add a separate country premium to this input. No empirical beta/ERP estimate is claimed.
input_policy.beta: Judgemental beta 1.0, not a regression. WACC case adjustments are explicit risk stresses.
input_policy.target_debt_weight: Exogenous long-run financing mix, not a market-cap weight derived from an unverified quote. This avoids price/WACC circularity.
input_policy.cost_of_debt: Analyst marginal nominal VND debt cost 5.5%, compared with forecast financing costs. Not an issuer commitment or observed new loan.
input_policy.tax: 20% normalised terminal and interest-tax-shield assumption. Explicit forecast retains case tax rates and incentive uncertainty.
input_policy.shares: 1,885,727,648 issued shares from 25 Sep 2026 issuer notice already visually verified in repository source register. Add a separate 1% unissued dilution reserve. No additional announced issue is asserted. Future bonus shares are neutral and not separately forecast.
input_policy.associate_pe: Analyst capitalisation multiple on 2027 FPT-attributable associate earnings, not a peer median or quoted FTEL multiple. This captures reinvested earnings as well as distributions. Do not add associate book value or future dividends again.
input_policy.nci: Forecast NCI book equity times 1.0-2.0 proxy because subsidiary market values are unavailable. This is a model risk. Earnings-share allocation would understate the substantial opening NCI capital.
input_policy.timing: Forward value at projected 31 Dec 2026 balance sheet. Q4 cash movements are in that balance sheet, so exclude Q4 FCFF. Annual FCFF uses mid-year timing 0.5-4.5. Gordon terminal stream also uses mid-year timing with terminal discount at 4.5, not 5.0.
input_policy.terminal: 2032 NOPAT uses 2031 EBIT, case g and normalised 20% tax. Reinvestment = NOPAT*g/ROIC, including operating cash needs. No extra CIP/PPE asset addition. Immediate stable-state transition is an explicit simplification.
input_policy.cash: Subtract required operating cash from projected year-end cash. Deduct subsequent annual increases in the reserve from FCFF. A below-floor balance remains a negative equity adjustment; no financing plug.
input_policy.price: No verified same-cutoff closing quote. Upside and market-implied reverse DCF remain unavailable. Hypothetical price probes are labelled as such. No comparison to the old Clock B price.
